summary: Cue Biopharma filed an 8-K reporting a license agreement with Ascendant Health Sciences Ltd. for anti-IgE antibody Ascendant-221. The deal includes a $15M upfront, up to $676.5M in milestones, and tiered royalties. This is an inbound licensing transaction, not a special situation category such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The filing is a routine material agreement disclosure. No special-situation event is triggered.
